title: [AI Business Solutions] Enforce allow-listed Redirect URIs, token audiences and authorities for OAuth2 integrations
summary: OAuth2 integrations now enforce allow-listed redirect URIs, token audiences, and authorities across intercompany, Outlook API, and SharePoint connectors to improve security.
key_points: Intercompany connector constructs authority from tenant GUID using HTTPS and login.microsoftonline.com
Outlook REST API redirect URI validated against OAuth2.GetDefaultRedirectUrl()
SharePoint connector documentation updated to recommend Sites.Selected over broad Sites.ReadWrite.All permission
SII Setup emits security audit and telemetry for invalid target URLs
Destination host validation hardened across OAuth2 integration points
quote: Construct authority from tenant GUID, use Https and login.microsoftonline.com
